integer_rules.shl7: retain low16bits of a*128; no saturating left shift
integer_rules.neon_qrdmulh: sat16(floor((2*a*b+32768)/65536)); doubled mathematical product is not truncated32
integer_rules.negated_multiplier: signed16(unsigned32(0-unsigned32(raw_multiplier))); defined for every int32 raw multiplier
integer_rules.rounding_ties: SQRDMULH and the selected RNU conversion both use ties toward positive infinity; they are not ties-away-from-zero or RNE.

source_expression_composition.scope: Only three exact pure-variable output/vy/lane0 source expressions, checked by full_inputs/check_neon_composed guards
source_expression_composition.construction: Borrow &vy once; in real adapter C copy all eight Char fields into a local int8x8_t, then evaluate the original canonical nested reinterpret/store expression. Original leaf bodies and all three actual adapters are mandatory typed closure units.
source_expression_composition.memory_bridge: Six universal full/undef-array versus byte-cell equivalences; initialized UChar/Char conversion uses bounded signed roundtrip, never undef-to-initialized conversion.
source_expression_composition.ownership: Borrowed input vector cells are preserved. Direct by-value caller recovery and indirect adapters with duplicate output ownership were rejected and archived. Native tests do not replace C/Coq proof.
source_expression_composition.boundary: No general theorem for side-effectful macro arguments, ISA/ABI compilation refinement or termination.
